assignmentHtml.task: Research HUM TV YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: Hum Network Limited. Corporate chain. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages (Urdu). (6) Primary content category (Pakistani TV dramas). (7) Content supply model: broadcaster archives. (8) Representative series. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: HUM TV is #47 with ~55B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for HUM TV with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
HUM TV YouTube Channel Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID & Canonical URL:

  • Channel ID: UCEeEQxm6qc_qaTE7qTV5aLQ
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@HUMTV (redirects to https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEeEQxm6qc_qaTE7qTV5aLQ)
  • Old handle before rebranding: @HumNetwork (https://www.youtube.com/user/HumNetwork)

(2) Operator & Corporate Chain:

  • Operator: Hum Network Limited
  • Corporate chain: Sultana Siddiqui (founder/chairwoman) → Hum Network Limited (publicly traded on Pakistan Stock Exchange under ticker HUMNL) → Hum TV (brand/channel)
  • Hum Network Limited was established February 2004 as Eye TV Limited, renamed Eye Television Network Limited on 18 Nov 2004, then to Hum Network on 21 Jan 2011
  • CEO: Duraid Qureshi; Headquarters: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
  • Subsidiaries include Hum TV Inc., Hum Network FZ LLC, Hum Network UK Limited

(3) Channel Creation Date & Earliest Still-Public Upload:

  • Channel created: 25 May 2011 (confirmed via Social Blade and YouTube's own 'About' page showing 'Joined May 25, 2011')
  • The channel operated as a 'dummy channel' until it was converted to the main channel in 2018
  • Earliest still-public upload: UNCERTAIN. Many early uploads (drama episodes from 2016–early 2017 including Udaari, Mann Mayal, Pakeeza, Gul-e-Rana, etc.) were deleted by early 2017 due to licensing deals (Netflix/Dish Network). Regular uploads resumed in 2018. Candidates for earliest surviving uploads include The After Moon Show (first aired 10 Feb 2018) and Chattkhara (HUM Network's first web-exclusive comedy drama, Episode 20 uploaded 12 May 2018, implying Episode 1 from ~early–mid 2018). Exact identity of the earliest still-public video could not be verified due to YouTube access restrictions.

(4) Operating Location & Displayed Country:

  • Operating location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
  • Displayed country: Pakistan (confirmed on channel metadata and Wikipedia)

(5) Languages:

  • Primary language: Urdu
  • Videos include English subtitles ([Eng Sub]) for global audience

(6) Primary Content Category:

  • Pakistani TV dramas (classified as 'Entertainment' on YouTube and Wikipedia)
  • Also includes OSTs, promos, award shows, web exclusives

(7) Content Supply Model:

  • Broadcaster archives: Episodes are uploaded to YouTube from the broadcaster's back catalogue and/or alongside/on-demand with television broadcasts
  • Pattern observed: Drama episodes uploaded weeks-to-months after original TV air date (e.g., Alif Allah Aur Insaan Ep1 aired Apr 2017, uploaded Aug 2019; Ehd-e-Wafa Ep1 aired Sep 2019, uploaded Sep 2019; Bin Roye Ep1 aired Oct 2016, uploaded Apr 2020)
  • Some shows deleted entirely due to licensing (O Rangreza, Sanam initially deleted 2017, re-uploaded muted in Oct 2019)

(8) Representative Series:

  • Humsafar (2011–12) – channel's most successful program, catalyzed 'Golden Age' of Pakistani TV
  • Zindagi Gulzar Hai (2012)
  • Sang-e-Mar Mar (2016)
  • Udaari (2016) – later deleted from YouTube
  • Sanam (2016) – deleted 2017, re-uploaded muted Oct 2019
  • Bin Roye (2016) – YouTube upload Apr 2020
  • Mann Mayal (2016)
  • Alif Allah Aur Insaan (2017–18) – YouTube upload Aug 2019
  • Suno Chanda (2018) – Ramadan hit, 91M views on Ep1
  • Deewar e Shab (2019)
  • Ehd-e-Wafa (2019–20)
  • Khushi, Zanjeerain, Gulbahar, Leader (current/upcoming 2026 titles)

Key Statistics (as of ~Sept 2026):

  • Subscribers: 55.2M
  • Lifetime views: ~55B
  • Video count: 225K+
  • Ranked #46–47 among most-viewed YouTube channels globally (Wikipedia lists #46 with 52.5B views; Social Blade shows 55B+)

evidence.snippet: Created On: May 25, 2011 | subscribers: 55M | views: 55B | videos: 225K | Grade: A
evidence.supports: Channel creation date (25 May 2011), subscriber count, view count, video count
YouTube's own about page confirming creation date and current statistics

evidence.snippet: Hum Network Limited was established in February 2004 with the name of Eye TV Limited by Sultana Siddiqui. The name was later changed to Eye Television Network Limited on 18 November 2004. The present name, Hum Network, was adopted on 21 January 2011. It was registered with Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority in October 2004 to operate its first satellite channel Hum TV which went live in January 2005. In June 2005, it was listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange... Subsidiaries: Hum TV, Inc.; Hum Network FZ LLC; Hum Network UK Limited...
evidence.supports: Corporate chain: Hum Network Limited ownership, founding history, PSX listing, subsidiaries

evidence.snippet: Hum TV HD is a 24-hour Urdu general entertainment TV channel based in Karachi, Pakistan. It was founded by Sultana Siddiqui and Duraid Qureshi in 2005. It is owned by Hum Network Limited and traded on the Pakistan Stock Exchange as (HUMNL). ... Hum Network, a Pakistani media company, is increasingly relying on its YouTube presence for revenue. ... The channel boasts over 51 million subscribers and 46 billion views ... Humsafar, broadcast in 2011–2012, has become the most successful program of the channel to date.
evidence.supports: Operator (Hum Network Limited), HQ (Karachi), language (Urdu), content type (TV dramas), most successful series (Humsafar)

evidence.snippet: Rank 46 | Channel name: HUM TV | Network: Hum Network | Views (billions): 52.5 | Content category: Entertainment | Country: Pakistan | Primary language(s): Urdu
evidence.supports: Global ranking (#46), content category (Entertainment), country, language

evidence.snippet: HUM TV has youtube channel since 2011-05-25. ... is from 'Pakistan (PK)', is in the 'Entertainment' category ... official website is https://www.hum.tv/
evidence.supports: Creation date confirmation, country, category, official website

evidence.snippet: Thread created 2017-02-23: 'I was going through their videos, and they have deleted videos of their popular shows from their YouTube channel' ... listed shows: Udaari, Mann Mayal, Pakeeza, Na Kaho Tum Meray Nahin, Gul-e-Rana ... 'HumTv made a deal with netflix so they cant have tv shows at YouTube anymore'
evidence.supports: Early 2017 deletion wave of popular drama episodes due to licensing deals

evidence.snippet: Chattkhara Episode #20 Comedy Drama WEB Exclusive HUM TV | Uploaded May 12, 2018 | 'the HUM Network's first ever web exclusive Comedy Drama series'
evidence.supports: Chattkhara as first web exclusive series, Episode 20 uploaded 12 May 2018, establishing 2018 as start of regular uploads after channel conversion

evidence.snippet: Suno Chanda Episode #1 Full HD official video at Hum TV official YouTube channel - 17 May 2018. (Note: video currently unavailable)
evidence.supports: Suno Chanda Ep1 uploaded 17 May 2018 (though now unavailable); shows 2018 upload activity

evidence.snippet: The show was also uploaded on YouTube alongside its airing on television but in 2017 the channel deleted all its episodes. ... In October 2019, the channel reuploaded all its episodes with muted music.
evidence.supports: Pattern of uploading, deleting (2017), and re-uploading (2019) episodes; explains why earliest public uploads are post-2018

evidence.snippet: Mann Mayal originally aired on Hum TV on 25 January 2016 to 5 September 2016, and was digitally released on Amazon Prime and Iflix.
evidence.supports: Drama aired Jan–Sep 2016; digital release via other platforms rather than YouTube, consistent with deletion pattern
